title: PremiseSQL: Evaluating Premise Critique and Abstention in Text-to-SQL Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.22158v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have substantially improved Text-to-SQL performance, yet existing NL2SQL systems largely assume that user queries are valid and answerable. As a result, models often generate executable SQL even for queries with flawed premises. We introduce premise critique ability in NL2SQL, namely the ability to recognize flawed queries and abstain from generating misleading SQL. To evaluate this capability, we propose PremiseSQL, a benchmark containing 1,800 flawed NL2SQL queries across four categories of premise failures, along with their 1,800 original queries. We further design an evaluation framework to measure intrinsic and prompt-induced premise-aware behavior across three prompting settings. Experiments on frontier LLMs show that current models are strongly premise-trusting by default and rarely critique flawed premises. translated_title: PremiseSQL：评估Text-to-SQL系统中的前提批判与拒绝回答能力
translated_abstract: 近年来大语言模型（LLM）的进展显著提升了Text-to-SQL的性能，然而现有的NL2SQL系统大多假设用户查询是有效且可回答的。因此，即使面对前提有缺陷的查询，模型也常常生成可执行的SQL。我们引入了NL2SQL中的前提批判能力，即识别有缺陷的查询并拒绝生成误导性SQL的能力。为了评估这一能力，我们提出了PremiseSQL基准，其中包含1,800条跨越四类前提故障的有缺陷NL2SQL查询，以及对应的1,800条原始查询。我们进一步设计了一个评估框架，用于在三种提示设置下测量模型的内在前提感知行为以及由提示诱导的前提感知行为。在前沿大语言模型上的实验表明，当前模型默认强烈信任查询前提，很少批判有缺陷的前提。更强的批判导向提示可以改善对有缺陷查询的检测和拒绝回答表现。
tldr: 该论文提出PremiseSQL基准，用于评估Text-to-SQL系统识别有缺陷查询前提并拒绝生成误导性SQL的能力，发现当前大模型默认过度信任查询前提，而批判导向的提示能够有效改善检测与拒绝回答的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PremiseSQL, a benchmark for evaluating the ability of Text-to-SQL systems to critique flawed query premises and abstain from generating misleading SQL, showing that current LLMs are premise-trusting by default while critique-oriented prompting improves detection and abstention.
